definitions.explanation: A substance added to food to prevent spoilage and extend shelf life by inhibiting bacteria, mold, and other microorganisms.

examples.japanese: この{食品|しょくひん}は{保存料|ほぞんりょう}{不使用|ふしよう}です。
examples.english: This food product contains no preservatives.

examples.japanese: {保存料|ほぞんりょう}を{使|つか}わないと{日持|ひも}ちしない。
examples.english: Without preservatives, it won't keep long.

examples.japanese: {保存料|ほぞんりょう}の{使用|しよう}を{気|き}にする{消費者|しょうひしゃ}が{増|ふ}えている。
examples.english: More consumers are concerned about the use of preservatives.

notes:
{保存料|ほぞんりょう} refers to food preservatives — substances added to prevent spoilage and extend shelf life. Composed of {保存|ほぞん} (preservation) + {料|りょう} (substance/material).

FOOD LABEL TERMS:
- {保存料|ほぞんりょう}{不使用|ふしよう}: preservative-free
- {保存料|ほぞんりょう}{無添加|むてんか}: no preservatives added
- {保存料|ほぞんりょう}を{含|ふく}む: contains preservatives

RELATED FOOD ADDITIVE TERMS:
- {添加物|てんかぶつ}: additive (general term)
- {着色料|ちゃくしょくりょう}: coloring agent
- {香料|こうりょう}: flavoring
- {甘味料|かんみりょう}: sweetener

USAGE:
Very common on food packaging in Japan. Health-conscious consumers often look for {保存料|ほぞんりょう}{不使用|ふしよう} labels.
